run_f_gold: run f_gold with n and k to compute frequency of k in an n by n matrix
test_f_filled_against_f_gold: test f_filled implementation against f_gold reference solution using 10 parameter sets
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which returns k minus 1 when n plus 1 is greater than or equal to k
review_f_gold_logic: review f_gold conditional logic that branches on whether n plus 1 is greater than or equal to k
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to compute frequency of value k in matrix where each cell equals row plus column index
